title: Load complete source closures and compatibility copybooks
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of closure_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: Legacy one-file SourceBundle identities remain unchanged; explicit ordered libraries use additive mainframe-env.source-libraries@1 identities.

Library order is semantic and deterministic. Duplicate names within one library, missing members, unknown paths, unassigned files, empty libraries, and symbolic-link discovery fail before artifact publication.
CLI compile, inspect, and run accept repeatable library directories and append the owned compatibility library after application precedence.
The composed JES COBOL route accepts fixed SYSIN plus ordered SYSLIB* DD members while preserving the existing free-form one-file route.
The public SourceBundle::with_libraries contract is the generic future installer input; no CardDemo behavior or physical path is embedded in production types.
DFHAID, DFHBMSCA, SQLCA, CMQGMOV, CMQMDV, CMQODV, CMQPMOV, CMQTML, and CMQV are repository-owned bounded definitions backed by published IBM behavior, not copied IBM source.

The corpus-backed closure gate reaches syntax for all 44 programs with 62 application/BMS and nine owned compatibility copybooks; all 44 closure identities are unique and all 346 expansions are selected without placeholder or native fallback.
